options.detail: Alternate spelling of --version. 0.6.14 accepts this after the command path. In 0.13.9 place --version directly after uv.

options.summary: Restrict versions of build dependencies
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --build-constraints. 0.13.9 only. Pass a requirements file. Its entries constrain the isolated build environment without adding a runtime dependency.

options.summary: Precompile Python modules after installation
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --compile-bytecode. uv processes Python files throughout site-packages, including previously installed modules. Installation takes longer but the first import can start faster.

options.summary: Pass a setting to the package build backend
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --config-setting. Supply KEY=VALUE for a PEP 517 build. Repeat for additional settings. The backend defines the accepted keys and values.

options.summary: Limit package versions during resolution
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --constraints. Supply a requirements-style constraints file. An entry narrows an existing requirement without adding the listed package to the project or tool.

options.summary: Omit packages named in an exclusions file
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --excludes. 0.13.9 only. A requirements-style file supplies the names. The resolver omits them and their dependencies regardless of markers or version constraints.

options.summary: Reinstall every package in the tool environment
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --reinstall. Refresh cached data even for packages already installed at the selected version.

options.summary: Load TLS roots from the operating system
options.detail: This is the public spelling in 0.6.14. In 0.13.9 it is a deprecated equivalent of --system-certs. The default uses bundled Mozilla roots.

options.summary: Use a temporary cache for this command
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --no-cache. The persistent cache is neither read nor updated. Downloads can still occur unless --offline is set.

options.summary: Leave Python bytecode compilation to imports
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --no-compile-bytecode. Overrides a request to precompile site-packages during installation. Python can still produce bytecode at runtime.

options.summary: Leave Python bytecode compilation to imports
options.detail: Overrides a request to precompile site-packages during installation. Python can still produce bytecode at runtime. Also written as --no-compile.

options.summary: Disable the general preview switch
options.detail: Use this to override an enabled blanket preview setting. Feature availability depends on the uv release.

options.summary: Replace dependency constraints from a file
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --overrides. Supply a requirements-style file. Its entries replace declared requirements and can produce a result outside the original constraints.

options.summary: Enable the release's experimental features
options.detail: Preview behavior can change between releases. In 0.13.9, --preview-features can enable selected features individually.

options.summary: Enable named experimental features
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --preview-features. 0.13.9 only. Use a comma-separated list or repeat the option. For example, index-by-name gives configured index names priority over relative paths in 0.13.9.

options.summary: Enable named experimental features
options.detail: 0.13.9 only. Use a comma-separated list or repeat the option. For example, index-by-name gives configured index names priority over relative paths in 0.13.9. Also written as --preview-feature.

options.summary: Trust a host without certificate verification
options.detail: Alternate spelling of --allow-insecure-host. Supply HOST, HOST:PORT or a URL. Repeat for additional hosts. HTTPS certificate checks are bypassed for listed hosts.
